definitions.gloss: shopping trip for supplies; bulk purchasing
definitions.explanation: going out specifically to buy supplies or provisions, often in larger quantities

examples.japanese: ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to go buy supplies for the party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧{買|か}い{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many households do their bulk shopping on weekends.

notes:
USAGE:
- {買|か}い{出|だ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go on a shopping trip)
- {買|か}い{出|だ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask someone to do the shopping)
- ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{出|だ}し (grocery shopping)
Implies a purposeful trip to acquire supplies, often for an event, meal preparation, or stocking up. Different from casual shopping (⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦まとめ{買|が}い→まとめ買い：08046_matomegai⟧ (bulk buying - the act of buying in quantity)
- ⟦{買|か}いだめ→買いだめ：08047_kaidame⟧ (stocking up)
- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧ (shopping - general)
